lemma cu_interval_abs_le_max:
  fixes l u x y :: real
  assumes ord: "l \<le> u"
    and x_in: "x \<in> {l..u}"
    and y_in: "y \<in> {l..u}"
  shows "\<bar>x - y\<bar> \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
proof -
  (* Extraemos las cotas que expresan que ambos puntos pertenecen al intervalo. *)
  have xl: "l \<le> x" and xu: "x \<le> u"
    and yl: "l \<le> y" and yu: "y \<le> u"
    using x_in y_in by auto

  (* Cada diferencia orientada queda acotada por uno de los dos márgenes. *)
  have mx: "x - l \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)" by simp
  have mu: "u - x \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)" by simp
  have upper: "x - y \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
    using yl mx by linarith
  have lower: "y - x \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
    using yu mu by linarith

  (* Las dos cotas orientadas implican la cota del valor absoluto. *)
  show ?thesis
    using upper lower by (simp add: abs_le_iff; linarith)
qed

lemma cu_interval_distance_to_margin:
  fixes l u x y :: real
  assumes ord: "l \<le> u"
    and x_in: "x \<in> {l..u}"
    and y_in: "y \<in> {l..u}"
  shows "\<bar>x - y\<bar> \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
proof -
  (* La pertenencia al intervalo da las cuatro cotas de orden necesarias. *)
  have xl: "l \<le> x" and xu: "x \<le> u"
    and yl: "l \<le> y" and yu: "y \<le> u"
    using x_in y_in by auto

  (* Cada margen está acotado por el máximo de ambos márgenes. *)
  have mx: "x - l \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)" by simp
  have mu: "u - x \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)" by simp

  (* Acotamos las dos orientaciones de la diferencia. *)
  have upper: "x - y \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
    using yl mx by linarith
  have lower: "y - x \<le> max (x - l) (u - x)"
    using yu mu by linarith

  (* Las cotas orientadas implican la cota del valor absoluto. *)
  show ?thesis
    using upper lower by (simp add: abs_le_iff; linarith)
qed

lemma cu_iterate_fixed_point_lipschitz_bound:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and S :: "real set"
    and c z q :: real and m :: nat
  assumes c_nonneg: "0 \<le> c"
    and z_in: "z \<in> S"
    and q_in: "q \<in> S"
    and invariant: "\<And>x. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> f x \<in> S"
    and lip: "\<And>x y. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> S \<Longrightarrow>
      \<bar>f x - f y\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
    and fixpoint: "f q = q"
  shows "\<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar> \<le> c ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
proof -
  (* La invariancia asegura que todas las iteraciones permanecen en S. *)
  have iter_in: "\<And>j. (f ^^ j) z \<in> S"
  proof -
    fix j
    show "(f ^^ j) z \<in> S"
    proof (induction j)
      case 0
      show ?case using z_in by simp
    next
      case (Suc j)
      have "f ((f ^^ j) z) \<in> S"
        by (rule invariant[OF Suc.IH])
      then show ?case by simp
    qed
  qed

  (* Inducimos la cota de la distancia al punto fijo. *)
  show ?thesis
  proof (induction m)
    case 0
    show ?case by simp
  next
    case (Suc m)
    (* La contracción compara la iteración actual con el punto fijo. *)
    have step:
      "\<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - f q\<bar> \<le> c * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar>"
      by (rule lip[OF iter_in[of m] q_in])

    (* Multiplicar por c conserva el orden porque c es no negativo. *)
    show ?case
    proof -
      have "\<bar>(f ^^ Suc m) z - q\<bar> =
          \<bar>f ((f ^^ m) z) - f q\<bar>"
        by (simp add: fixpoint)
      also have "\<dots> \<le> c * \<bar>(f ^^ m) z - q\<bar>"
        by (rule step)
      also have "\<dots> \<le> c * (c ^ m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>)"
        by (rule mult_left_mono[OF Suc.IH c_nonneg])
      also have "\<dots> = c ^ Suc m * \<bar>z - q\<bar>"
        by (simp add: power_Suc algebra_simps)
      finally show ?case .
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma cu_iterate_preserves_set:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and S :: "real set" and x :: real and m :: nat
  assumes x_in: "x \<in> S"
    and invariant: "\<And>y. y \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> f y \<in> S"
  shows "(f ^^ m) x \<in> S"
proof (induction m)
  case 0
  (* La iteración de orden cero deja el punto inicial sin cambios. *)
  then show ?case using x_in by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  (* La invariancia aplica a la iteración anterior, que permanece en el conjunto. *)
  have "f ((f ^^ m) x) \<in> S"
    by (rule invariant[OF Suc.IH])
  then show ?case by simp
qed

lemma cu_posteriori_scalar:
  fixes c s t d :: real
  assumes c_nonneg: "0 \<le> c"
    and c_lt_one: "c < 1"
    and contraction: "s \<le> c * t"
    and triangle: "t \<le> d + s"
  shows "s \<le> c / (1 - c) * d"
proof -
  (* El denominador de la cota es positivo. *)
  have denominator_pos: "0 < 1 - c"
    using c_lt_one by linarith

  (* Multiplicamos la desigualdad triangular por el factor no negativo. *)
  have scaled_triangle: "c * t \<le> c * (d + s)"
    using triangle c_nonneg by (rule mult_left_mono)

  (* Combinamos esta cota con la contracción. *)
  have combined: "s \<le> c * (d + s)"
    using contraction scaled_triangle by linarith

  (* Separamos el producto para aislar la distancia s. *)
  have expanded: "s \<le> c * d + c * s"
    using combined by (simp add: algebra_simps)

  (* Reordenamos para obtener la cota multiplicada por el denominador. *)
  have rearranged: "(1 - c) * s \<le> c * d"
  proof -
    have identity: "(1 - c) * s = s - c * s"
      by (simp add: algebra_simps)
    show ?thesis
      using identity expanded by linarith
  qed

  (* Dividimos por el denominador positivo. *)
  have rearranged': "s * (1 - c) \<le> c * d"
    using rearranged by (simp add: mult.commute)
  have divided: "s \<le> (c * d) / (1 - c)"
    using denominator_pos rearranged'
    by (simp add: pos_le_divide_eq)

  (* Reescribimos el cociente en la forma solicitada. *)
  have ratio_identity: "(c * d) / (1 - c) = c / (1 - c) * d"
    by (simp add: divide_inverse; algebra)
  show ?thesis
    using divided ratio_identity by linarith
qed

lemma cu_lipschitz_continuous:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" and S :: "real set" and L :: real
  assumes L_nonneg: "0 \<le> L"
    and lip: "\<And>x y. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> S \<Longrightarrow>
      \<bar>f x - f y\<bar> \<le> L * \<bar>x - y\<bar>"
  shows "continuous_on S f"
proof (rule continuous_onI)
  fix x :: real
  fix e :: real
  assume epos: "0 < e" and xS: "x \<in> S"
  let ?d = "e / (L + 1)"

  (* El denominador positivo permite elegir una distancia positiva. *)
  have denom: "0 < L + 1" using L_nonneg by linarith
  have dpos: "0 < ?d" using epos denom by (rule divide_pos_pos)

  (* La cota de Lipschitz para esta distancia no supera e. *)
  have Ld: "L * ?d \<le> e"
  proof -
    have Lbound: "L \<le> L + 1" using L_nonneg by linarith
    have product_bound: "L * ?d \<le> (L + 1) * ?d"
    proof (rule mult_right_mono)
      show "L \<le> L + 1" by (rule Lbound)
      show "0 \<le> ?d" using dpos by linarith
    qed
    have cancel: "(L + 1) * ?d = e"
      using denom by (simp add: field_simps)
    show ?thesis using product_bound cancel by simp
  qed

  (* La cota Lipschitz y la cercanía dan la condición epsilon-delta. *)
  show "\<exists>d>0. \<forall>x'\<in>S. dist x' x < d \<longrightarrow> dist (f x') (f x) \<le> e"
  proof (intro exI[of _ ?d] conjI)
    show "0 < ?d" by (rule dpos)
    show "\<forall>x'\<in>S. dist x' x < ?d \<longrightarrow> dist (f x') (f x) \<le> e"
    proof (intro ballI impI)
      fix x'
      assume x'S: "x' \<in> S" and close: "dist x' x < ?d"
      have lipx: "\<bar>f x' - f x\<bar> \<le> L * \<bar>x' - x\<bar>"
        by (rule lip[OF x'S xS])
      have close_abs: "\<bar>x' - x\<bar> < ?d"
        using close by (simp add: dist_real_def)
      have product_bound: "L * \<bar>x' - x\<bar> \<le> L * ?d"
      proof (rule mult_left_mono)
        show "\<bar>x' - x\<bar> \<le> ?d" using close_abs by linarith
        show "0 \<le> L" by (rule L_nonneg)
      qed
      have abs_bound: "\<bar>f x' - f x\<bar> \<le> e"
        using lipx product_bound Ld by linarith
      show "dist (f x') (f x) \<le> e"
        using abs_bound by (simp add: dist_real_def)
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma cu_abs_distance_between:
  fixes r t s :: real
  assumes rt: "r \<le> t" and ts: "t \<le> s"
  shows "\<bar>t - r\<bar> \<le> \<bar>s - r\<bar>"
    and "\<bar>t - s\<bar> \<le> \<bar>r - s\<bar>"
proof -
  (* El orden determina los signos de las diferencias. *)
  have tr_nonneg: "0 \<le> t - r" using rt by linarith
  have sr_nonneg: "0 \<le> s - r" using rt ts by linarith
  have ts_nonpos: "t - s \<le> 0" using ts by linarith
  have rs_nonpos: "r - s \<le> 0" using rt ts by linarith

  (* Simplificamos los valores absolutos usando esos signos. *)
  have tr_abs: "\<bar>t - r\<bar> = t - r"
    using tr_nonneg by (simp add: abs_of_nonneg)
  have sr_abs: "\<bar>s - r\<bar> = s - r"
    using sr_nonneg by (simp add: abs_of_nonneg)
  have ts_abs: "\<bar>t - s\<bar> = s - t"
    using ts_nonpos by (simp add: abs_of_nonpos)
  have rs_abs: "\<bar>r - s\<bar> = s - r"
    using rs_nonpos by (simp add: abs_of_nonpos)

  (* Reescribimos las diferencias antes de compararlas. *)
  have diff1: "t - r \<le> s - r" using rt ts by linarith
  show "\<bar>t - r\<bar> \<le> \<bar>s - r\<bar>"
    using diff1 tr_abs sr_abs by (simp only: tr_abs sr_abs; linarith)

  (* La segunda comparación también se reduce a r ≤ t. *)
  have diff2: "s - t \<le> s - r" using rt by linarith
  show "\<bar>t - s\<bar> \<le> \<bar>r - s\<bar>"
    using diff2 ts_abs rs_abs by (simp only: ts_abs rs_abs; linarith)
qed

lemma cu_abs_product_square:
  fixes z :: real
  shows "\<bar>z\<bar> * \<bar>z\<bar> = z\<^sup>2"
proof (cases "0 \<le> z")
  case True
  (* Para z no negativo, su valor absoluto es z. *)
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: abs_of_nonneg power2_eq_square)
next
  case False
  (* Para z no positivo, su valor absoluto es -z. *)
  have zn: "z \<le> 0" using False by linarith
  have absz: "\<bar>z\<bar> = -z"
    using zn by (simp add: abs_of_nonpos)
  show ?thesis using absz by (simp add: power2_eq_square; algebra)
qed

lemma cu_scale_abs_quadratic:
  fixes c x y :: real
  assumes c_nonneg: "0 \<le> c"
    and bound: "\<bar>y\<bar> \<le> c * x\<^sup>2"
  shows "c * \<bar>y\<bar> \<le> (c * \<bar>x\<bar>)\<^sup>2"
proof -
  (* El cuadrado de un valor absoluto coincide con el cuadrado original. *)
  have x_sq_nonneg: "0 \<le> x * x"
  proof -
    have "0 \<le> x\<^sup>2" by (rule zero_le_power2)
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: power2_eq_square)
  qed
  have abs_prod: "\<bar>x\<bar> * \<bar>x\<bar> = x\<^sup>2"
  proof -
    have "\<bar>x\<bar> * \<bar>x\<bar> = \<bar>x * x\<bar>" by (simp add: abs_mult)
    also have "\<dots> = x * x" using x_sq_nonneg by simp
    finally show ?thesis by (simp add: power2_eq_square)
  qed
  (* Escalamos la hipótesis por el factor no negativo c. *)
  have scaled: "c * \<bar>y\<bar> \<le> c * (c * x\<^sup>2)"
    by (rule mult_left_mono[OF bound c_nonneg])
  (* Reescribimos el extremo derecho como el cuadrado deseado. *)
  have identity: "(c * \<bar>x\<bar>)\<^sup>2 = c * (c * x\<^sup>2)"
    using abs_prod by (simp add: power2_eq_square algebra_simps)
  show ?thesis
    using scaled identity by simp
qed

lemma cu_abs_divide_bound:
  fixes a b c :: real
  assumes b_pos: "0 < b"
    and a_bound: "\<bar>a\<bar> \<le> b * c"
  shows "\<bar>a / b\<bar> \<le> c"
proof -
  (* La división por un denominador positivo preserva el orden. *)
  have " \<bar>a\<bar> / b \<le> (b * c) / b"
    using a_bound b_pos by (intro divide_right_mono) auto
  also have "... = c"
    using b_pos by simp
  finally show ?thesis
    using b_pos by (simp add: abs_divide)
qed

  finally show ?thesis
